evals.expected_output: A full pass: state diff, inventory, shipped tooling work, update-tooling refresh, machine upgrades including claude update and claude doctor, background-process audit, machine metrics (echo test only on a trigger), config audit, a verdict-first report, a questionnaire, and a recorded state file.

evals.prompt: Typing in Claude Code in Ghostty feels laggy. Make it faster.

Counts open Claude Code sessions and checks load, ~/.claude.json size, and orphaned temp files
